captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0 so the reel's own captions carry the words
steps: run onsets.py      # 0. optional: frame-exact word onsets, if you time by hand
run more.py      # 1. optional, more plate; then its clean cutout: PY scripts/rvm_cut.py <slot> --src work/more.mp4 --out work/more.webm
run prep.py      # 2. track, measure, clean plate. LOOK at work/plate_check.jpg
run build.py CAPTIONS=0      # 3. variant, timing, index.html. Read the printout (or the DECLINE line)
run bake.py      # 4. assets/fx.mp4 (PY bake.py --frames 40-48 previews a few frames)
run build.py CAPTIONS=0      # 5. guide off again (with the switches you want, e.g. CAPTIONS=0 SFX=0)
run post.py      # 6. frame count, phone copy, stills, work/qa/sheet_*.jpg
